---
title: "Welcome"
---

*Reading the Game* takes you from watching football casually to understanding it at a
high level, so you can see the play coming before the snap.

It assumes you've watched plenty of games and maybe played Madden, but never played or
coached. Terms like *nickel*, *Power I* or *Cover 2* may sound familiar without meaning
much yet. By the end you'll know what each one is, why it exists, where it came from,
and how to spot it on a broadcast.

## How to use this course

- **Read it in order** the first time. Each chapter builds only on earlier ones.
- **Look things up** later: use the search box, the [Glossary](appendices/glossary.qmd),
  or the reference atlas.
- **Print it**: every chapter has a printable PDF (link at the top right of each
  chapter, or see [all PDFs](appendices/pdfs.qmd)).
- **Play with the diagrams**: every play is drawn in Python with the `gridiron`
  library, in the same coordinates as the NFL Big Data Bowl's tracking data. Open
  "Show the Python" under any diagram to see the code.
